message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterful psychological thriller with iconic imagery and a chilling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A deeply unsettling family drama that blends supernatural terror with real‑world grief. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspenseful, low‑noise tension that keeps you on edge throughout. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation that balances dread with solid storytelling. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that turns the sunny setting into a nightmare. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood through a sinister entity. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of a Japanese classic that delivers a creepy, atmospheric vibe. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget found‑footage style that still manages to keep you uneasy. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a slow‑burn psychological scare or a fast‑paced jump‑saw experience!
